message: Unable to find any standard cell pin connected to the VDD_PM net.
root_cause: VDD_PM is a netlist-level protected-PM supply domain. The 441 leaf INVD8 protection cells (instance basename PMRowBLK_*) have their physical power pin named 'VDD' connected to a module-local VDD_PM net inside the PM_VDDI_Inst subtree; that local net reaches the top level only through the hierarchy port PM_VDDI_Inst(.VDD_PM). Consequently the top-level VDD_PM net carries exactly 1 hierarchical instTerm and 0 leaf standard-cell pins. The original floorplan script issued an unconditional globalNetConnect 'VDD_PM -instanceBasename PMRowBLK_* -netType power' with no generation probe, no VERIFY-vs-ROUTE distinction and no explicit physical pin name, so pin resolution found no standard-cell pin on the VDD_PM net and raised IMPSR-1253.
summary_zh: 根因：VDD_PM 是网表级 PM 保护供电隔离域。441 个 INVD8 保护单元（实例基名 PMRowBLK_*）的物理电源脚名为 VDD，在 PM_VDDI_Inst 子层次内连接到模块局部 VDD_PM 网络，该局部网络仅通过层次端口 PM_VDDI_Inst(.VDD_PM) 引出到顶层。因此顶层 VDD_PM 网络只有 1 个层次 instTerm、0 个叶子标准单元引脚。原版 fp 脚本的 globalNetConnect 未探测网表代次、未区分 VERIFY/ROUTE、也未显式指定物理引脚名，导致无法在 VDD_PM 上找到任何标准单元引脚，触发 IMPSR-1253。
contributing_factors: globalNetConnect omits the explicit -pin/-pg_pin name, so the tool does not learn that the leaf physical power pin is named 'VDD' (not 'VDD_PM')
VDD_PM is exposed at the top level only through the PM_VDDI_Inst hierarchy port, leaving 0 direct leaf std-cell pins on that net object
the floorplan script is unconditional: no netlist generation probe and no VERIFY branch to distinguish the hierarchy-port-only case

evidence.gnc_search: searched pin 'VDD' on PMRowBLK_* -> 0 leaf std-cell pin connected

corrective_action: Make the floorplan script generation-aware and netlist-aware: (1) probe the netlist generation; (2) enumerate supply nets from power.globals/UPF; (3) add a VERIFY step that computes leaf std-cell pin count vs hierarchical instTerm count and treats the hierarchy-port-only case as an expected floorplan event; (4) connect the isolated domain net to the discovered physical leaf power pin (e.g. 'VDD') using explicit -pin plus hierarchy descent (-hierarchicalInstance), while scoping the generic VDD/VSS connects to exclude the protection-domain leaves so every power pin is driven exactly once.
